questions.question: Which instrument and unit would you use to weigh Ethan, and which to weigh butter?
questions.expected_answer: Use a bathroom scale and kilograms for Ethan, because a person is heavy. Use a kitchen scale and grams for butter, because it is light.

questions.question: Which is heavier, 1,2 kg of flour or 950 g of sugar? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Change to the same unit: 1,2 kg is 1 200 g. 1 200 g is more than 950 g, so the flour is heavier.

questions.question: On a dial, the numbers go up by 100 g and there are 4 small marks between them. What is each small mark worth?
questions.expected_answer: The 4 marks split each 100 g into 5 equal spaces, so each small mark is worth 100 divided by 5, which is 20 g.
